title: Kis tarah baap se beti ko chudaaya hoga
body:
Shaame gariba ....2
Baap ke sine pe sar rakhkar Sakina so gae Aur durra leke aa pohcha wahan shimre laae....
Baap ki lash pe beti ko joh paaya hoga...
<<MINI>>
Allah jaane.. Allah jaane.. kis tarah baap se beti ko chudaaya hoga.... 2
kis tarah baap se beti ko chudaaya hoga....
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Kitni raat Se wo jaagi hue masooma thi, Baap ki lash Se lipti toh osse neend aae, Markar durra joh zaalim ne jagaaya hoga.....
<<MINI>>
Allah jaane.. Allah jaane.. kis tarah baap se beti ko chudaaya hoga.... 2
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Marta tha kabhi durre kabhi pathar wo shakhi, Fhir bhi lipti rahi lasshe Se judaa hoti na thi, Nooch kar baal jo zaalim me uthaya hoga, Allah jaane.. Allah jaane.. kis tarah baap se beti ko chudaaya hoga.... 2
3. Bekasi kaisi thi gham Kaisa jafaa kaisi thi, Har tamache pe wo ghaazi ko sadaa deti thi, Khoon Abbas ne ankho Se bahaya hoga, Allah jaane.. Allah jaane.. kis tarah baap se beti ko chudaaya hoga.... 2
4. Dhundne bachi ko maqtal me joh Zainab pohchi, Khoo Me tar baap ke laashe pe khadi thi beti, Nauha Zainab ke labon par yahi aaya hoga, Allah jaane.. Allah jaane.. kis tarah baap se beti ko chudaaya hoga.... 2
5. Betiyon walo zara socho wo manzar haae, Baap ki laash pe beti ne tamache khaae, Khoon rukhsaaro Se us dam nikal aaya hoga....
<<MINI>>
Allah jaane.. Allah jaane.. kis tarah baap se beti ko chudaaya hoga.... 2
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ek shab aaya joh zindaan me sare Shahe anam, Muh pe muh rakha Sakina ne hue saase tamam, Waqt jab ghuslo kafan dene ka aaya hoga.....
<<MINI>>
Allah jaane.. Allah jaane.. kis tarah baap se beti ko chudaaya hoga.... 2
<<DIVIDER>>
Nauha farhaan ne jis dam ye sunaaya hoga
<<MINI>>
Allah jaane.. Allah jaane.. kis tarah baap se beti ko chudaaya hoga.... 2
